title: Automated failover rehearsal scheduler with KV-drift scorer and dependency brittle detector
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Ship an automated scheduler that runs low-risk active->passive failover rehearsals weekly and generates a KV-drift score plus brittle-dependency alerts. This reduces manual coordination for DR drills, surfaces data divergence early, and quantifies regression risk via a scoring metric used in on-call handoffs and postmortems. The facility should support: (1) dry-run mode (no traffic switch), (2) canary switch (small percentage traffic), and (3) full switch (controlled failover). It must play well with existing circuit-breaker and load-shedding policy toggles, and output artifacts consumable by Console and SRE dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduler can be configured via Console or YAML and run on a Cron (weekly default)
Each rehearsal produces a KV-drift score (0-100) and a human-readable drift diff artifact stored in S3/GCS
Brittle dependency detector raises alerts when >2 external subsystems show >5% increased error or latency during dry-run
Rehearsal runbook executes traffic fencing, circuit-breaker priming, canary percentage ramp, and rollback within configured SLO windows
Artifacts link into a new 'DR Rehearsals' dashboard with time-series of drift, failover time, and rollback latency
Role swap path can be executed in <20 minutes for canary and <45 minutes for full switch in our staging environment
Automated smoke checks validate write-after-read semantics post-restore with >= 99.9% success before marking rehearsal Done
steps: Design scheduler configuration schema and API with Console UX (support cron, timezone, dry_run flag)
Implement rehearsal engine in infra: orchestration that sequences fencing, prime-circuit-breakers, canary ramp, and rollback hooks
Build KV-drift scorer: snapshot comparison + probabilistic sampling to compute divergence, weight by key TTL and write frequency
Add brittle-dependency detector by correlating subsystem error/latency deltas with rehearsal timeline
Wire artifacts to storage (S3/GCS) and publish links to Console and post-rehearsal Slack summary
Enable telemetry: rehearsal duration, rollback time, canary success rate, drift score, and NRT alerts
Add safety gates: abort conditions for production rehearsals (error spike threshold, <2 minutes grace for operator abort)
Create automated smoke-check suite for verifying read-after-write and semantic integrity after restore
